notes.title: ver.1.0.4
notes.content: Fixed a bug where an error would occur if a sound device could not be found due to support in the production tool.

notes.title: ver.1.0.2
notes.content:
Due to improved functionality of the production tool, you can now see achievements and rankings from the configuration screen.
Fixed an issue with fairies in the final area.
(Please note that previous replays will no longer be played correctly due to the version update.)

notes.title: ver.1.0.1
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the "zuttoz" achievement was not unlocked.
